description: Create, destroy, or modify plot items associated with a plot. If no plot name is specified, the current view is assumed. Plot items control what is visualized in the plot. Item type list below verified against PFC2D 7.00; PFC3D adds CFD items (ball-cfd, clump-cfd, element-cfd) and plug-ins can add more.

plot_items.label: Axes
plot_items.description: Cartesian axes representation for view orientation and location reference

plot_items.label: Ball
plot_items.description: Balls colored by attributes or properties. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items ball') for configuration keywords

plot_items.label: Ball Thermal
plot_items.description: Thermal balls colored by attributes or properties

plot_items.label: History Chart
plot_items.description: Line chart of one or more history traces. Requires a data source: append 'history <name>' to bind a history by its Name (the Name column from 'history list', NOT its numeric ID). Repeat 'history <name>' for multiple traces; add 'vs <name>' to cross-plot against another history instead of vs step. A chart-history created without a valid 'history <name>' draws an empty chart with no error.

plot_items.label: Table Chart
plot_items.description: Chart of a table

plot_items.label: Clump
plot_items.description: Clumps colored by attributes or properties. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items clump')

plot_items.label: Clump Thermal
plot_items.description: Thermal clumps colored by attributes or properties

plot_items.label: Contact
plot_items.description: Contacts colored by attributes or properties. This is the force-chain item: combine 'color-by vector-attribute "force"' with 'scale-by-force on'. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items contact')

plot_items.label: Contact Thermal
plot_items.description: Thermal contacts colored by attributes or properties

plot_items.label: Labels
plot_items.description: User defined labels

plot_items.label: Scalars
plot_items.description: User defined scalar data

plot_items.label: Tensors
plot_items.description: User defined tensor data

plot_items.label: Vectors
plot_items.description: User defined vector data

plot_items.label: DFN Fracture Contour
plot_items.description: Contour mechanical contact data on DFN fractures. Creation REQUIRES the contour keyword: 'plot item create dfn contour' (bare 'plot item create dfn' is an error). Not the item for drawing fractures themselves - use 'fracture' for that

plot_items.label: Domain
plot_items.description: Domain geometry (model domain extent)

plot_items.label: Factor of Safety
plot_items.description: Last calculated factor of safety, displayed in legend

plot_items.label: Fracture
plot_items.description: Fractures from the Discrete Fracture Network system. Cannot color by parent DFN directly ('dfn' is not a valid color-by attribute); assign 'fracture group' per DFN and color by group instead. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items fracture')

plot_items.label: Geometry
plot_items.description: Geometry data created or imported

plot_items.label: Gp Fixity
plot_items.description: Lines showing gridpoint fixity conditions and direction (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: History Locations
plot_items.description: Location of history traces

plot_items.label: Inlet
plot_items.description: Ball/clump inlet geometry

plot_items.label: Measure
plot_items.description: Measurement regions (circles in 2D, spheres in 3D) colored by attributes

plot_items.label: Particle Trace
plot_items.description: Path taken by particle trace records

plot_items.label: Rigid Block
plot_items.description: Rigid blocks colored by attributes or properties. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items rblock')

plot_items.label: Rigid Block Thermal
plot_items.description: Thermal rigid blocks colored by attributes or properties

plot_items.label: Thermal Analytical Source
plot_items.description: Analytical thermal sources

plot_items.label: Wall
plot_items.description: Walls colored by attributes or properties. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items wall')

plot_items.label: Wall Thermal
plot_items.description: Arrows corresponding to thermal walls' vector attributes or properties

plot_items.label: Zone
plot_items.description: Surfaces of zones in the range (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Attach Conditions
plot_items.description: Attach conditions connecting gridpoints (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Face
plot_items.description: Zone faces within the range (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Profile
plot_items.description: Profile of zone field values along a line (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Tensors
plot_items.description: Tensor values of zones (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Vectors
plot_items.description: Vector-based zone values (coupled zone models)

plot_items.label: Water Table
plot_items.description: Water table used for pore pressures (coupled zone models)

notes: Plot item configuration keywords (color-by, cut, transparency, legend) are documented in references: use itasca_browse_reference('plot-items') to list available item types, then itasca_browse_reference('plot-items ball') for full keyword documentation

chart-history and chart-table need an explicit data source. For chart-history, bind a trace with 'history <name>' where <name> is the Name column from 'history list' (NOT the numeric ID); passing an ID, an unknown name, or omitting the keyword draws an empty chart with no error. Repeat 'history <name>' for multiple traces; add 'vs <name>' to cross-plot against another history. See itasca_browse_reference('plot-items chart-history').

Item indices in 'modify <i>'/'delete <i>' are 1-based creation-order positions within one plot, and delete renumbers the items that follow. When scripting, keep one plot per purpose and rebuild it ('plot clear' then create items in a fixed order) rather than modifying by remembered index.

Force chains: use the contact item with 'scale-by-force on'. 'radius-factor' and a bare 'automatic'/'automatic off' are NOT contact-item keywords (verified PFC2D 7.00, they fail with 'Unused extra parameter'); the word 'automatic' is only valid inside 'color-options ... minimum automatic maximum automatic'.

To discover configuration keywords empirically, issue a deliberately incomplete command: the engine error lists the expected tokens (e.g. 'plot item create zzz' lists every item type). Do NOT use 'plot export datafile' for this from a script or the MCP bridge - in PFC 7 it takes no filename and opens a GUI file dialog, which blocks the process.
Additional plot items can be added by plug-ins; PFC3D adds CFD items (ball-cfd, clump-cfd, element-cfd)

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('plot item create <type>') - no direct Python SDK method

keywords.name: create
keywords.description: adds a new plot item to the list associated with the plot. An alphabetical list of keywords, matched to the items available from the Build Plot dialog , is shown below. Note that additional plot items can be added by plug-ins to the system at any time.

keywords.name: delete
keywords.description: destroys the i th plot item in the list associated with the current plot. Note that this will renumber the plots following that in the list.

keywords.name: modify
keywords.description: allows modification of the existing plot item at the i th position in the list associated with the current plot.

examples.description: Add balls to the current plot

examples.command: plot item create contact active on color-by vector-attribute 'force' color-options scaled ramp rainbow minimum automatic maximum automatic scale-by-force on legend active on
examples.description: Force-chain item: contacts colored and thickness-scaled by force magnitude (verified PFC2D 7.00)

examples.command: plot item create fracture color-by text-attribute 'group' Any
examples.description: Draw DFN fractures colored by their group (assign per-DFN groups first with 'fracture group <name> range fish <fn>' or at crack creation time); the slot argument after 'group' is required - a slot name string or Any

examples.command: plot item create fracture range group 'tension_cracks'
examples.description: A fracture item restricted to one crack family via group range ('range dfn <name>' does NOT select by DFN membership - the dfn range element is distance-based)
Chart the history named 'ratio' (the Name column from 'history list', NOT its numeric ID). A chart-history with no 'history <name>', or a name/ID no history has, draws an empty chart with no error

examples.command: plot 'myplot' item create chart-history history 'stress' vs 'strain'
examples.description: Cross-plot one history against another (x-y) instead of the default 'vs step'
Delete the first plot item (following items are renumbered)

examples.command: plot item modify 2 legend active off
